name: @vicsee/mcp-server

tools.name: vicsee_list_models
tools.description: List available VicSee models with their capabilities and credit costs. Call this first to find a model id to pass to vicsee_generate. Optionally filter by media type.

tools.name: vicsee_estimate
tools.description: Return the EXACT credits a vicsee_generate call will charge, without generating anything. Takes the same arguments as vicsee_generate. The server runs the identical validation, model/resolution resolution and per-second billing (probing any reference video for its length) and stops before the charge, so `credits` is what vicsee_generate will deduct. Also returns `resolvedParams` (the settings that will actually apply, including defaults you did not send), `creditsRemaining` and `sufficient`. Call this before vicsee_generate whenever the user cares about cost, is comparing models, or is attaching a video reference (per-second billing across input + output). Invalid requests return the same error vicsee_generate would, so it also works as a free dry run. Exception: the content-policy check runs only on vicsee_generate, so an estimate does not tell you whether a prompt will be blocked.

model.description: Model id from vicsee_list_models — exactly what you will pass to vicsee_generate

prompt.description: The prompt you will send (required for most models)

image_urls.description: As for vicsee_generate. Public https URLs (nothing is inlined for an estimate).

reference_image_urls.description: As for vicsee_generate. Public https URLs.

reference_video_urls.description: As for vicsee_generate. Include it: a video reference switches billing to per-second and the estimate probes the clip length.

video_url.description: Video-edit models only, as for vicsee_generate.

audio_setting.description: Video-edit models only, as for vicsee_generate.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Send it explicitly; the default is often not the cheapest tier.

resolution.description: As for vicsee_generate. Send it explicitly; the default on most video models is NOT the cheapest tier.

extra.description: Any additional model-specific params, as for vicsee_generate

tools.name: vicsee_generate
tools.description: Create an AI image or video with VicSee. Generation is ASYNCHRONOUS: this returns a task `id` immediately, then poll `vicsee_get_task` with that id until status is "completed" (the result URL appears in result.url) or "failed". Use vicsee_list_models to pick a `model` and see its valid options. For image-to-video / image-to-image, pass source images in `image_urls`. For reference-to-video models (e.g. "seedance-2-5-reference-to-video"), pass references in reference_image_urls / reference_video_urls / reference_audio_urls and refer to them positionally in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, … For native 2K output at the best value per second use the "minimax-h3-*" models (MiniMax H3, also called Hailuo 03): 4-15s, 768P/2K, always-on stereo audio, billed per second (25 credits/s at 768P, 40 at 2K). Note "minimax-h3-image-to-video" takes the first frame in image_urls[0] and an optional last frame in image_urls[1], and has NO aspect_ratio parameter — the ratio follows the frames; "minimax-h3-reference-to-video" requires at least one image OR video reference (audio alone is rejected) and accepts at most 5 reference images. For clips longer than 15 seconds use the "seedance-2-5-*" models, which generate up to 30 seconds (480p/720p only, no 1080p or 4K); the "seedance-2-0-*" models cap at 15 seconds but add 1080p and 4K. Note that supplying a video reference switches billing to per-second across input + output, so a long reference clip costs considerably more than the duration table suggests. When cost matters, call vicsee_estimate with the same arguments FIRST — it returns the exact credits this call will charge and creates nothing. IMAGE inputs (image_urls, reference_image_urls) must be a public https URL, or a local file path (prefer vicsee_upload for anything larger than a thumbnail — inline base64 gets truncated in tool-call output and rejected). VIDEO/AUDIO inputs (reference_video_urls, reference_audio_urls) must be public https URLs. For video-edit models (e.g. "happyhorse-video-edit"), pass the source clip in video_url and optionally set audio_setting ("auto" or "origin"). Input images must have an aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5 (width÷height) and at most 36MP — wide-strip composites (e.g. 3:1) are rejected; use a 2×2 grid layout instead. On "failed" tasks, read error.key and error.message from vicsee_get_task — they state the actual reason (do not guess). CONTENT POLICY: every request is checked before it runs (prompt and every input image). Sexual or nude content is not allowed, real or fictional. A block returns error code CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION (HTTP 422), creates no task and uses no credits. Do not retry the same request or rephrase it to get around the check: repeated blocks suspend the account. MODERATION_UNAVAILABLE (HTTP 503) means the check could not run; retry after a short wait.

model.description: Model id from vicsee_list_models, e.g. "nano-banana-pro-text-to-image" or "seedance-2-5-text-to-video"

prompt.description: Text prompt (required for most models). Pass it here as a plain string — this server builds the correct request envelope for you, so you never need to decide between a top-level prompt and input.prompt.

image_urls.description: Source image(s) for image-to-video / image-to-image. Each may be a public https URL, or a local file path (prefer vicsee_upload for anything larger than a thumbnail — inline base64 gets truncated in tool-call output and rejected).

reference_image_urls.description: Reference-to-video only. Per-model caps: Seedance 2.5 up to 10, the 2.0 family (2.0 / Fast / Mini) up to 7, MiniMax H3 up to 5. ALWAYS confirm against maxImages in vicsee_list_models — that is the authoritative value and these numbers can lag. Each may be a public https URL, or a local file path (prefer vicsee_upload for anything larger than a thumbnail — inline base64 gets truncated in tool-call output and rejected). Refer to them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, …

reference_video_urls.description: Reference-to-video only: up to 3 public https video URLs, each 2s or longer. TOTAL across all clips must not exceed 30s on Seedance 2.5, or 15s on the 2.0 family (2.0 / Fast / Mini) and MiniMax H3. The total is the binding limit, not the per-clip length. NOTE: supplying a video reference switches billing to per-second across input + output on every model that supports it, so a long clip costs far more than the output duration suggests.

reference_audio_urls.description: Reference-to-video only: up to 3 public https audio URLs. TOTAL across all clips must not exceed 30s on Seedance 2.5, or 15s on the 2.0 family. MiniMax H3 accepts up to 3 audio clips but requires at least one IMAGE or VIDEO reference as well — audio alone is rejected. Accepted: mp3, wav, aac, m4a, ogg.

video_url.description: Video-edit models (e.g. "happyhorse-video-edit") only: one public https video URL, 3-15s, to edit.

audio_setting.description: Video-edit models only: "auto" (regenerate audio) or "origin" (keep the source audio).

duration.description: Video length in seconds (e.g. 5, 6, 10, 15) — video models only

resolution.description: Model-specific — call vicsee_list_models and use a value from that model's options.resolution. The families do NOT share an enum: minimax-h3-* accept ONLY "768P" or "2K" (no 720p, 1080p or 4K); seedance-* use lowercase "480p"/"720p"/"1080p"; image models use "1K"/"2K"/"4K". Omitting it takes that model's default, which on most video models is NOT the cheapest tier — send it explicitly.

audio.description: Enable native audio (supported video models). Not applicable to MiniMax H3, which always generates audio and has no toggle — the field is ignored there.

nsfw_checker.description: Seedance 2 only. Set false to relax the provider content/audio sensitivity filter (helps when benign dialogue/SFX is wrongly flagged). Honored ONLY for approved partner accounts; ignored otherwise. Model-level safety always applies.

extra.description: Any additional model-specific params (see the model's options from vicsee_list_models)

tools.name: vicsee_get_task
tools.description: Poll a generation or upscale task by its id. IMPORTANT: finished media URLs are kept for 7 days only — result.expires_at is the exact time the URL stops working; download or re-host anything the user wants to keep. status is one of "pending" | "processing" | "queued" | "completed" | "failed". When "completed", the media URL is in result.url (videos/images) or result.songs (music). When "failed", details are in error. Poll every few seconds until completed or failed.

task_id.description: The task id returned by vicsee_generate / vicsee_upscale_*

tools.name: vicsee_upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale a publicly accessible image (JPEG/PNG/WebP). Asynchronous: returns a task id — poll vicsee_get_task until completed. upscale_factor defaults to "2" (max "4"). Credits are tiered by OUTPUT size (input megapixels × factor²): ≤24MP = 20, ≤48MP = 40, ≤96MP = 80; outputs above 96MP are rejected.

tools.name: vicsee_upscale_video
tools.description: Upscale a publicly accessible video (MP4/MOV/MKV, up to 60s). Asynchronous: returns a task id — poll vicsee_get_task until completed. upscale_factor defaults to "2".

tools.name: vicsee_get_credits
tools.description: Get the current VicSee credit balance for the configured API key.

tools.name: vicsee_upload
tools.description: Upload a LOCAL file (image, video, or audio) from this machine and get back a public https URL. Use the returned url as an input for vicsee_generate — e.g. drop it into reference_image_urls for a reference-to-video storyboard, or image_urls for image-to-video. PREFER this over inline base64 for references: large base64 strings get truncated in tool-call output and the model rejects them. The file uploads directly to storage; only its public URL comes back.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file (image/video/audio) on this machine.

stderr: VicSee MCP server running on stdio.
